metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 CLI in [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with its [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). It handles JSON requests, GEDCOM tree inspection and rendering, and GEDZIP creation and inspection with stored and deflate ZIP entries.

Build succeeded with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build` when run from `/workspace/output`.

One limitation: GEDCOM checks cover stream syntax and key container rules, but do not fully validate every Chapter 3 record grammar, data type, and cardinality rule.
